notes.content:
- increased Gold earnings per Level to 25,000
 - increased starting Gold to 2,500
 - changed Berserk Skill availability to Level 1

 - increased max Zoom for 1st and 3rd Camera Views

- changed Health and Stamina Potions price to 100 coins each
- added Shop Button next to Dungeon Skill Slots
- fixed bug for Berserk and Rage when pausing
- bound UP, DOWN, LEFT and RIGHT arrow keys to Player Navigation
